github-docs-code-security-configurations:
About security configurations

Security configurations define settings for GitHub Code Security and GitHub Secret Protection, including secret scanning and push protection.
github-docs-rest-api-versions:
About API versioning

The GitHub REST API uses the X-GitHub-Api-Version header. Removing or renaming a response field is a breaking API change.
